top_spender: (defn top_spender [] (let [ks (vec (sort (distinct (map (fn [c] (get c "key")) (get (state) "calls" [])))))] (if (empty? ks) nil (reduce (fn [best k] (if (> (cost k) (cost best)) k best)) ks))))
over_quota: (defn over_quota [key extra] (let [q (quota_for_key key)] (and (some? q) (> (+ (usage_total_for_key key) extra) q))))
usage_record: (defn usage_record [key model tokens] {"key" key "model" model "tokens" tokens})
set_price: (defn set_price [model cents_per_1k_tokens] (when-not (non_empty_string model) (throw (ex-info "model must be a non-empty string" {}))) (when-not (and (number? cents_per_1k_tokens) (not (< cents_per_1k_tokens 0))) (throw (ex-info "price must be a non-negative number" {}))) (swap-state! assoc-in ["prices" model] cents_per_1k_tokens) cents_per_1k_tokens)
record_usage: (defn record_usage [key model tokens] (when-not (non_empty_string key) (throw (ex-info "key must be a non-empty string" {}))) (when-not (non_empty_string model) (throw (ex-info "model must be a non-empty string" {}))) (when-not (positive_whole_number tokens) (throw (ex-info "tokens must be a positive whole number" {}))) (when (over_quota key tokens) (throw (ex-info "call exceeds quota for key" {}))) (swap-state! update "calls" (fnil conj []) (usage_record key model tokens)) (usage_total_for_key key))
set_quota: (defn set_quota [key tokens] (when-not (non_empty_string key) (throw (ex-info "key must be a non-empty string" {}))) (when-not (positive_whole_number tokens) (throw (ex-info "quota must be a positive whole number" {}))) (when (> (usage_total_for_key key) tokens) (throw (ex-info "quota below tokens already used" {}))) (swap-state! assoc-in ["quotas" key] tokens) tokens)
